title: Modular Model Implementations
summary: This module provides modular implementations of various transformer models, including causal language models, sequence classification models, and conditional generation models, often leveraging specialized architectures like MoE or multi-modal capabilities.

nodes.label: AFMOE Causal LM
nodes.title: AFMOE Causal Language Model
nodes.description: A causal language model based on the AFMOE architecture, designed for text generation tasks. It incorporates Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers for efficient processing and supports various generation parameters.

nodes.label: BLT Causal LM
nodes.title: BLT Causal Language Model
nodes.description: A causal language model that supports cross-attention mechanisms, enabling interaction with external features like image tiles for multi-modal generation. It processes text and visual inputs.

nodes.label: ColModernVBert Processor
nodes.title: ColModernVBert Data Processor
nodes.description: A multi-modal processor for ColModernVBert models, handling image preparation, text query processing, and computing late-interaction retrieval scores for document understanding and search.

nodes.label: DeepseekV4 Core Model
nodes.title: DeepseekV4 Base Model
nodes.description: The foundational model for DeepseekV4, featuring DeepseekV4DecoderLayer, DeepseekV4RotaryEmbedding, and DeepseekV4HyperHead. It provides the core architecture for advanced language processing tasks.

nodes.label: Evolla Protein Text2Text
nodes.title: Evolla Protein Text-to-Text Model
nodes.description: A specialized model for protein-related text-to-text generation, capable of answering questions about protein sequences and structures. It integrates protein-specific inputs for contextual understanding.

nodes.label: FalconH1 Core Model
nodes.title: FalconH1 Base Model
nodes.description: The core FalconH1 model, incorporating FalconH1DecoderLayer and FalconH1RotaryEmbedding. Designed for efficient sequence processing with Mamba-like mechanisms, it forms the backbone for FalconH1-based tasks.

nodes.label: Gemma4 Text Model
nodes.title: Gemma4 Core Text Model
nodes.description: The base text model for Gemma4, featuring Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) and specialized attention mechanisms. It enhances language understanding and generation by integrating context-aware and token-identity signals.

nodes.label: JetMoe Causal LM
nodes.title: JetMoe Causal Language Model
nodes.description: A causal language model utilizing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to improve performance and efficiency in text generation tasks. It includes mechanisms for load balancing across experts.

nodes.label: ModernBertDecoder Sequence Classification
nodes.title: ModernBertDecoder for Sequence Classification
nodes.description: A decoder-based model for sequence classification tasks, capable of handling various problem types like regression, single-label, and multi-label classification. It processes hidden states for final predictions.

nodes.label: Qwen2.5 Omni Conditional Generation
nodes.title: Qwen2.5 Omni Multi-modal Generation
nodes.description: A multi-modal model for conditional generation, capable of generating both text and audio responses. It integrates 'thinker' for text, 'talker' for speech tokens, and 'token2wav' for audio synthesis.

nodes.label: Qwen3Next Core Model
nodes.title: Qwen3Next Base Model
nodes.description: The foundational model for Qwen3Next, featuring Qwen3NextDecoderLayer, Qwen3NextRMSNorm, and Qwen3NextRotaryEmbedding. It supports both causal and linear attention mechanisms for diverse applications.

nodes.label: SwitchTransformers Encoder-Decoder
nodes.title: SwitchTransformers Encoder-Decoder Model
nodes.description: An encoder-decoder model based on the Switch Transformers architecture, designed for sequence-to-sequence tasks. It leverages Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for efficient and scalable processing across layers.

nodes.label: SwitchTransformers Encoder
nodes.title: SwitchTransformers Encoder-only Model
nodes.description: An encoder-only model based on the Switch Transformers architecture, suitable for tasks requiring only encoding capabilities. It leverages Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for efficient feature extraction.

nodes.label: T5Gemma Sequence Classification
nodes.title: T5Gemma for Sequence Classification
nodes.description: A T5Gemma-based model for sequence classification, configurable to use either an encoder-decoder or encoder-only architecture. It applies a classification head to the final hidden states for predictions.

nodes.label: T5Gemma Token Classification
nodes.title: T5Gemma for Token Classification
nodes.description: A T5Gemma-based model for token classification, configurable to use either an encoder-decoder or encoder-only architecture. It predicts labels for each token based on the model's hidden states.

nodes.label: T5Gemma Conditional Generation
nodes.title: T5Gemma for Conditional Generation
nodes.description: A T5Gemma-based encoder-decoder model for conditional text generation, supporting masked language modeling loss and tied weights. It generates sequences based on input prompts and encoder outputs.

nodes.label: T5Gemma2 Sequence Classification
nodes.title: T5Gemma2 for Sequence Classification
nodes.description: A T5Gemma2-based encoder-decoder model for sequence classification, supporting multi-modal inputs like pixel values. It processes combined text and image features for classification tasks.

nodes.label: T5Gemma2 Token Classification
nodes.title: T5Gemma2 for Token Classification
nodes.description: A T5Gemma2-based encoder-decoder model for token classification, supporting multi-modal inputs like pixel values. It assigns labels to individual tokens within multi-modal sequences.

nodes.label: T5Gemma2 Conditional Generation
nodes.title: T5Gemma2 for Conditional Generation
nodes.description: A T5Gemma2-based encoder-decoder model for multi-modal conditional generation, handling text and image inputs for diverse generation tasks. It supports advanced caching for efficient inference.

nodes.label: Zamba2 Sequence Classification
nodes.title: Zamba2 for Sequence Classification
nodes.description: A Zamba2-based model for sequence classification tasks, extending the Zamba architecture with updated model components. It performs classification on pooled hidden states from the model.

nodes.label: Zamba2 Causal LM
nodes.title: Zamba2 Causal Language Model
nodes.description: A Zamba2-based causal language model, extending the Zamba architecture for text generation tasks. It generates text sequentially based on previous tokens and model context.

groups.label: Generative Models
groups.title: Generative Models
groups.description: Components primarily designed for generating text, audio, or other sequences.

groups.label: Analytical Models
groups.title: Analytical Models
groups.description: Components primarily designed for classification, prediction, or other analytical tasks.

groups.label: Data Processors
groups.title: Data Processors
groups.description: Components for preparing input data or processing outputs, often handling multi-modal inputs.

groups.label: Core Model Architectures
groups.title: Core Model Architectures
groups.description: Foundational model components that provide the base architecture for various tasks, often wrapped by task-specific heads.
